answer: Each identity must pay a real, repeatable cost to enter: clear seventeen audited assignments, escrow 190 units for two epochs, collect four endorsements from established peers whose records never overlap. A clone reruns every job and locks fresh escrow, and a disproved job burns it. Since receipts are single-use and endorsers cannot be shared, borrowed standing is empty, so every extra puppet costs far more than the ballot weight it can yield. pulse pigment thread
